Condition : 1 - 1.	The two internally illuminated poster units permited by this consent shall be permanently removed from the site by 29 July 2006, the period of express consent, unless a further period of consent has been granted by the local planning authority. 
	(Reason.  To accord with the terms of the Inspectors decision on APP/F5540/H/03/1113388 and in the interests of the amenities of the area.)
2.	All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
	(Reason.  To accord with the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisement) Regulations 1994)
3.	Any structure or hoarding erected or use principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.
	(Reason.  To accord with the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisement) Regulations 1994)
4.	Where any advertisement is required under these regulations to be removed, the removal shall be carried out to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
	(Reason.  To accord with the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisement) Regulations 1994)
5.	No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant planning permission.
	(Reason.  To accord with the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisement) Regulations 1994)
6.	No advertisement shall be sited or displayed so as to obscure, or hinder, the ready interpretation of any road sign, railway sign or aid to navigation by water or air so as to otherwise render hazardous the use of any highway, railway, waterway (including any coastal waters) or aerodrome (civil or military).
	(Reason.  To accord with the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisement) Regulations 1994)
